name: smartlistener
description: Smart Listener-Based Cross-Chain Communication System (Bigiotti et al. 2025)

scripts.listeners: concurrently -k -n ListenerA,ListenerB,ListenerC,ListenerD -c magenta,darkMagenta,pink,red "cd listener && npx cross-env LISTENER_ID=A npm run start" "cd listener && npx cross-env LISTENER_ID=B npm run start" "cd listener && npx cross-env LISTENER_ID=C npm run start" "cd listener && npx cross-env LISTENER_ID=D npm run start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n Node,API,Dashboard -c magenta,darkMagenta,pink "npm run node" "npm run api" "cd dashboard && npm run dev"
